panels.title: Heartbeat age
panels.description: Seconds since the last supervisor_alive tick (live series, shadow=0i). ~60s is healthy; a climbing value means the status_heartbeat loop is wedged or the process is dead. The supervisor_alive staleness alert is the hard backstop.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_alive" and r._field == "alive" and r.shadow == "0i")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0 }))

panels.title: Loop lag (now)
panels.description: Latest supervisor_tick lag_s — cycle overrun vs the intended cadence. Near 0 is healthy; a sustained rise means the event loop is starved (blocking IO on the loop thread).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_tick" and r._field == "lag_s" and r.shadow == "0i")
  |> last()

panels.title: Memory budget free
panels.description: Latest supervisor_tick budget_free_pct — MemoryBudget headroom the admission-concurrency model protects. Low free % (red) means jobs are queueing against the OOM ceiling.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_tick" and r._field == "budget_free_pct" and r.shadow == "0i")
  |> last()

panels.title: Fires (24h)
panels.description: Total job dispatches in the last 24h (sum of supervisor_tick fired, live series). Zero over a full day means the loop is up but nothing is being triggered — worth a look.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_tick" and r._field == "fired" and r.shadow == "0i")
  |> sum()

panels.title: Loop lag (history)
panels.description: supervisor_tick lag_s over time — the wedged-loop signal. Spikes correlate with blocking work on the event loop.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_tick" and r._field == "lag_s" and r.shadow == "0i")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: Memory budget (used vs total)
panels.description: supervisor_tick budget_used_mb against budget_total_mb — the MemoryBudget occupancy the concurrency admission control exists to protect.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_tick" and (r._field == "budget_used_mb" or r._field == "budget_total_mb") and r.shadow == "0i")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Dispatch by trigger source
panels.description: supervisor_tick by_cron / by_event / by_backstop — the fire-on-clock vs fire-on-content split. A healthy event-gated loop leans on by_event; by_backstop rising means the event edge is being missed.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_tick" and (r._field == "by_cron" or r._field == "by_event" or r._field == "by_backstop") and r.shadow == "0i")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: doit — executed vs up-to-date
panels.description: supervisor_tick doit_executed vs doit_uptodate — the 'skipped because fresh' ratio. High up-to-date means content-hash gating is paying off (work skipped as already-current).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_tick" and (r._field == "doit_executed" or r._field == "doit_uptodate") and r.shadow == "0i")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Skips & crashes
panels.description: supervisor_tick skipped_overlap / skipped_circuit / crashes. Overlap = a prior run still going; circuit = a cooled-down job held off; crashes = runner exceptions (should stay flat at 0).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_tick" and (r._field == "skipped_overlap" or r._field == "skipped_circuit" or r._field == "crashes") and r.shadow == "0i")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Fan-out edges (mirror / repo)
panels.description: supervisor_mirror.moved (vault git-mirror SHA advances → content jobs) and supervisor_repo.moved (owner push advances → dev-wiki jobs). These are the event edges that trigger work between cron ticks.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_mirror" and r._field == "moved")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_repo" and r._field == "moved")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

panels.title: Per-job run health
panels.description: supervisor_step ok per job (shadow=0i), one row per job — green=ok, red=failed. This is the per-job history the aggregate panels above can't show (a job can fail cleanly inside run_once without moving the loop-level crashes counter, which only counts an escaped runner exception). A gap on a frequent job (cron/event jobs report roughly every schedule interval) is itself a signal that it stopped reporting. Live snapshot equivalents: the #ops obsidian-supervisor Discord embed's failing-job list, and `supervisor.supervisord --status`.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ops")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supervisor_step" and r._field == "ok" and r.shadow == "0i")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.job}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
